Entire source-authored fixture operation grammar required; initial-only or shortened cases reject.
coverage.policy: Reconstruct all31 frozen structural values, exact canonical NULL plus every pending ready/waiting action, stable epsilon mixture and analytic mixture gradient. Saved explicit fixture draws are checked against source-declared midpoints; no RNG claim.
coverage.scheduler: Global dead before global forced; earliest generation before smaller later degree; primitive steps must be exact selected-row complete-domain members.
coverage.whole_record: Rebuild exact source BodyAuthority and fixture wrapper records; all constituent full identities, ordered repeated readers and offset channels, aggregate occupancy/remote mark union. Five actual source-authored registration corruptions rederive expected rejection with no partial salvage.
coverage.rollback: Deep snapshots reconstruct graph/hints and active ID/revision alongside exact checkpoint depth. History/work metrics remain cumulative. Actual zero-attempt unchanged solver tape verifies UNKNOWN produces no parent exclusion.
coverage.counters: Every observed graph work counter and Controller integer counter rederived from frozen source call semantics. Wall time fields are finite nonnegative observations, while full owner/ROOT clocks and kernel/sample memory independently qualify resources.
coverage.auditor_mutants: After future actual positive audit, make12 copies of saved output and actually call independent audit on missing scenario/event, whole aggregate, lost domain key, hint status, feature vector, draw flag, probability, mixture gradient, pending-as-fact reward, broken paired rollback and UNKNOWN exclusion. No rejection booleans accepted without actual calls.
